reason: The code supports the revert, but triggering it requires a MANAGER/owner to change the handler through an authorized admin function. The report acknowledges this trusted-role precondition, so the issue is not eligible as a vulnerability finding.

evidence.claim: Re-pointing an asset's slashing handler via allowlistAssets makes NativeVault.slashAssets revert (NotSlashStore), DoSing slashing for existing NativeVaults whose slashStore differs.
evidence.support_reason: NativeVault.slashAssets reverts unless slashingHandler == self.slashStore (NativeVault.sol:308). SlasherLib.finalizeSlashing passes self.assetSlashingHandlers[asset] (SlasherLib.sol:135-138), and CoreLib.allowlistAssets overwrites that mapping with no check against existing vaults (CoreLib.sol:67-75). So changing the handler for DEAD_BEEF makes finalizeSlashing revert for NativeVaults whose slashStore is the old handler.
preconditions: MANAGER/owner calls allowlistAssets to re-point Constants.DEAD_BEEF to a different handler than an existing NativeVault's slashStore
A slashing request for that NativeVault is finalized after the change
